mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the service hatch was worthwhile because it preserved access to the controller and counterweight after skinning the whale.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the mount and module felt routine; those steps offered little feedback beyond confirming the assembly.

surprise.text: The final result explained that the battery and counterweight sit low so the whale’s weight hangs below the lift.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the chapter explained the order and the purpose of keeping the controls accessible.

continue.text: I would continue to see whether the assembled whale can fly safely and how the fair fits aboard, though this chapter’s assembly steps were mostly predictable.
